headline: All four readers now key the store by (ticker, asset_name) in code and fixtures. On the pinned store none of them changes a row or an existing value: census presence changes for 0 of 4000 tickers and the name-free row count is equal (5,186,000); basis census removes or changes 0 of 3,163,974 yahoo ticker-day series values; the custodian reader has 0 CUSIP-valued store rows; the provenance selection is 0 rows either way. Two-name ticker-days: SCCO 1027, APH 70, others 274,481 (all sources, non-null ticker). No served figure moves: none of the four writes an S3 object. The as-written AC1 invocation errors at collection (rc=2, duplicate package name tests, present at HEAD before any edit); the 28 tests pass per file (6, 3, 19) and under --import-mode=importlib, twice. row_w158_s2_disarms is not_established: the channel row ADVI_COTBKF-D2-W158-S2 is written about the minted-table consumers, not the ticker-only readers (surprise ADVI_COTBKF-D2-W166-S4).
not_established: AC1 as written: pytest rc=2 at collection (ModuleNotFoundError tests.test_commonwealth_price_census) because data/assets/scripts/silver/tests and data/assets/scripts/analysis/tests are both packages named tests; present at HEAD before any edit; the packaging fix is outside this order's paths (surprise ADVI_COTBKF-D2-W166-S1). The 28 figure is from per-file runs and from --import-mode=importlib runs.

The four main() read-only runs were not made: census main lists every bucket and writes deliverables; basis census main calls Yahoo (barred); custodian main needs the transactions table (not on this box) and writes a deliverable; provenance main lists every object version of opal-data-cot. Before and after were measured through each reader's own functions on the local copy of the pinned object, with HEAD copies (git show HEAD:<file>) for the old side (surprise ADVI_COTBKF-D2-W166-S3).

Basis census classes (as_traded, mixed and the rest) were not re-run because Yahoo calls are barred; the yahoo series is identical before and after on the pinned store (0 values changed, 0 days removed or added), so the class inputs are identical.

Custodian name test: its effect needs the bond's transaction Security_Description, which is not on this box; the reader has 0 CUSIP-valued rows on the pinned store, so the name test cannot change a row here.

The census universe does not read security names. On the pinned store, for all 4000 tickers (price greater than 0 rows), the union of dates equals the largest single asset_name's date count, so presence by ticker equals presence by name here. This is a measurement on the store, not a proof for a future store.

Served-figure answer: none of the four writes an S3 object (no put, upload or write call in any of the four files; their writes are local deliverable files). The consumer record CONSUMER_READ.json reads the minted tables, not this store, and the store's gold consumers (B_00, B_01, B_02, A_03, E_00, E_01) are not touched by this change.

row_w158_s2_disarms is not_established, not true: the four readers are keyed in code and tests, but the channel row ADVI_COTBKF-D2-W158-S2 is written about the minted-table consumers, and the census presence view remains ticker-level by design (presence is name-neutral on the store). The disarm act belongs to disarm_owner 1.0.0_SA_CTO~DELL2; this worker did not edit the row.

Item 2 literal rule: implemented as the price-conditional rule (a two-name ticker-day is left out only where its yahoo rows disagree on price). The literal branch would have removed 177,413 price-equal yahoo ticker-days (surprise ADVI_COTBKF-D2-W166-S2).
